trigger_condition: Teams service account supplies a valid sender_email for a user with no access to the assistant/project
guard_snippet: if not user_can_access_assistant(billing_user, assistant): raise ExtendedHTTPException(403,...)
potential_consequence: Access control still runs against the service account, so billing/usage attribution to an unauthorized end-user bypasses per-user authorization

trigger_condition: sender_email resolves to a UserDB row that is inactive or deleted
guard_snippet: if not db_user.is_active: raise ExtendedHTTPException(404, 'sender_email user is inactive')
potential_consequence: Usage, budget spend, and request-summary attribution charged to a deactivated account with no warning

trigger_condition: sender_email equals another service_account user's email
guard_snippet: if db_user.user_type == 'service_account': raise ExtendedHTTPException(400, 'sender_email must be a human user')
potential_consequence: Billing/usage silently attributed to a second service account instead of a real Teams end-user

trigger_condition: Migrated ms_teams settings row is later edited through the normal update API
guard_snippet: INSERT ... alias = :alias with a generated non-null alias, e.g. f'ms-teams-{project_name}'
potential_consequence: Settings.check_alias_unique raises 'Alias is required' on update because the migrated row's alias column is NULL

trigger_condition: ms_teams setting created/updated for a project_name that does not exist or is soft-deleted
guard_snippet: if not application_repository.get_by_name(project_name) or app.deleted_at: raise ExtendedHTTPException(404,...)
potential_consequence: ms_teams integration is created against a nonexistent or deleted project, unlike the retired AssistantProjectMappingService which validated project existence

trigger_condition: setting_id in the URL does not match any existing Settings row
guard_snippet: existing_setting = Settings.get_by_id(setting_id)\nif existing_setting is None: raise ExtendedHTTPException(404, 'Setting not found')
potential_consequence: existing_setting is None and .project_name raises AttributeError, surfaced as a generic 422 instead of 404

trigger_condition: Non-admin/non-maintainer caller submits an MS_TEAMS create request with project_name omitted
guard_snippet: if request.credential_type == CredentialTypes.MS_TEAMS and not request.project_name: raise 400 before permission check
potential_consequence: _check_permission runs first and raises a misleading 403 'project None' instead of the intended 400 'project_name is required'

trigger_condition: Assistant delete/move pruning fails (DB error) inside the caller's broad try/except
guard_snippet: On failure, enqueue a retry/reconciliation job instead of only logger.warning
potential_consequence: Stale assistant_id silently lingers in an ms_teams settings row with no way to detect or heal the drift later

trigger_condition: Large number of ms_teams settings rows across all projects
guard_snippet: filter get_all_by_fields further by relevant projects or paginate the scan
potential_consequence: Every assistant delete or project-move triggers an unbounded full scan of all ms_teams rows, growing linearly with customers
